primary_estimand: Effect of loss of mechanical stress (knee immobilization + tail-suspension unloading, MMS) on cartilage gene expression over time (D3/D7/D14/D28 vs control), and its reversal by restored joint motion (R1) or motion + loading (R2). This is a disuse/unloading model, not an exercise intervention; R1/R2 are remobilization/reloading.
planned_contrasts: each MMS time point vs Control (cartilage); R1 and R2 vs Control/MMS — shown only as heatmaps/module patterns (S2.3.p1/S2.4.p1, Figs 2-4); no DEG counts reported
gene selection: FC MMS D28/control <0.67 or >1.5 with FPKM>1 -> 1606 genes (S4.8.p2)

paper_threshold.note: fold change >= 2.0 and FDR <= 0.001 (BGI PoissonDis); inclusive on both cutoffs

paper_method: BGI PoissonDis on full transcriptome (S4.7.p1); iDEP 0.91 for clustering/PCA on FPKM (S4.8.p1)
inclusion: male C57BL/6J; one mouse (both knees pooled) per sample; n=2/group for cartilage (S4.7.p1)
paper_results: named genes only (synovium: Spp1, Col1a1, Ibsp, Col1a2, Postn, Mmp13, Mmp9, Il1b, Il11, Ccl2, Osm, Lif, Tgfb1, Tgfb3 up; cartilage: Col2a1, Col11a1, Col11a2, Acan, Prg4, Sox9, Sox5 down); no DEG counts
